authority.principle: discovery, identity, capability, reputation, and observation are evidence inputs, not authority grants

agent_counterparty_contract_alpha.name: Agent Counterparty Contract Alpha
agent_counterparty_contract_alpha.purpose: A machine-readable reference for services that want an agent to understand what an action means before committing to it and how to reconcile it afterward.

evidence_basis.source: Machine Realms bounded research and public agent-system discussions
evidence_basis.interpretation: design requirements, not certification or consensus
recurring_needs: outcome states that distinguish unknown from failed
receipts that state what they prove and what they do not prove
evidence freshness, supersession, challenge, and revocation

authorization.principle: authentication proves control of an identity; it does not prove mandate for the requested effect

intent.principle: durably record consequential intent before the external side effect when the implementation controls persistence

commercial.principle: price and charge semantics should be knowable before authorization whenever possible

execution.principle: completed is an outcome claim and should identify the evidence that supports it

receipt.principle: a receipt should state what it proves; payment, execution, correctness, settlement, and fulfillment are different claims

recovery.retry_default: reuse the same idempotency key for the same intended operation; do not invent a new operation merely because the response was lost
recovery.principle: unknown must not be automatically converted to failed or safe-to-repeat

evidence_lifecycle.purpose: Make evidence freshness, challenge, supersession, and revocation explicit instead of treating a past observation as permanently current.
evidence_lifecycle.principle: evidence has a lifecycle; absence of current evidence remains unknown rather than silently becoming true or false

recommended_fields.observed_at: When this evidence was directly observed or produced.
recommended_fields.valid_until: Optional explicit evidence horizon after which the evidence must be treated as stale unless re-observed.
recommended_fields.challenged_at: When a challenge was recorded, if any.
recommended_fields.supersedes: Stable evidence or claim identifier replaced by this record, if any.
recommended_fields.superseded_by: Stable evidence or claim identifier that replaced this record, if known.
recommended_fields.revoked_at: When the issuer or steward explicitly withdrew this evidence, if applicable.
recommended_fields.revocation_reason: Bounded machine-readable reason for withdrawal when available.
recommended_fields.source_version: Policy, schema, tool, or contract version under which the evidence was produced.

rules: superseded evidence remains historical evidence but is not the current decision basis
revocation must not be represented as deletion of history
stronger direct evidence should outrank declaration-only evidence
conflicting evidence should remain visible as conflict rather than being silently collapsed
